'''Faime Gosan''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who [[Coruscanti/Legends|hailed]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]]<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the last few [[Local year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], she frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="DB" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of her homeworld.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> 

During a [[Standard day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Gosan descended down and exited<ref name="AotC" /> a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> in the Outlander Club, just as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered, [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|searching]] for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] after her assassination attempt on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. While Skywalker surveyed the club crowd, Gosan stood at a table with a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] and two other Humans.<ref name="AotC" /> The clubgoer had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin, blonde hair,<ref name="DB" /> and a feminine first name of Human origin.<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> She wore a red [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] with black [[Boot/Legends|boots]] while at the club.<ref name="AotC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Faime Gosan first appeared, portrayed by an uncredited extra, in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AotC" /> in scenes shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Prior to the film's release on [[May 16]], [[2002]],<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> a picture of Gosan was included in the image archive [[Episode II Select]] on [[StarWars.com]] on [[March 29]], [[2001]].<ref name="EpIISelect">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/select|text=Episode II Select Archive}}</ref> Gosan was first identified in an Episode II [[Depth Commentary]] available on StarWars.com that could be accessed through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones''<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref>
